name: multi-rigid-body system
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 由多个刚体通过悬挂、铰接或其他连接组成的动力学系统。
usage_overview: 主要用于车辆子系统建模，将车体、构架和轮对等部件视为刚体，以悬挂及连接元件表达相互作用，求解车辆各方向运动；刚体划分和自由度数随车型与研究目标确定，不固定为某一套车辆模型。

Generally, the vehicle is regarded as multi-rigid-body system and the tracks are modelled as an entire elastic system or rigid-elastic hy-brids in vehicle-track dynamical analysis,.

Vehicle–track interaction, which is generally regarded as a hybrid model of vehicle multi-rigid-body system and track elastic system, aims to solve problems related to dynamics analysis, performance assessment, parameterisation design and maintenance for vehicle–track systems.

First, a coupled model, with the satisfaction of wheel–rail displacement compatibility and force equilibrium within each time step, is constructed for the characterisation of vehicle–track interaction, where the vehicle is modelled as a multi-rigid-body system, the ballasted tracks are modelled as a combination of elasticity, damping and mass structures by finite-element method, and time-varying wheel–rail contacts in geometry, creep and force are depicted at the three-dimensional space.

In this work, the finite element modeling methods and related computer modules are presented to compile a simulation program to evaluate the slab track damage evolution accompanied by vehicle-track dynamic interaction, where the moving vehicle is modeled as a multi-rigid-body system with the primary and secondary suspensions, and the Bernoulli-Euler beam, thin-plate and solid finite element and spring-dashpots are introduced to model the track system.
The train is modelled as a multi-rigid-body system consisting of several identical vehicles.
The vehicle is modeled as a multi-rigid-body system consisting of a car body, two bogie frames, and four wheelsets.
The vehicle is modeled as a multi-rigid-body system with 38 DOFs, including a car body, two bogies and four wheelsets.
